subject: Contoso Partner Center seller anchor map & next steps
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Contoso Partner Center seller anchor map & next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for agreeing to walk through the Partner Center referral mapping with us today. We pulled together an initial "anchor map" that attempts to stitch Contoso account IDs to field sellers and Partner Center referral owners so we can reduce ownership friction when a co-sell lead comes in. Attached is the workbook (contoso_account_anchor_map_v2.xlsx).

Quick summary and asks: 
- What we built: a tab with Contoso account IDs, likely account name variants, current Partner Center referral owner, and the field seller (MSFT) listing we believe is the right contact.
- What we need from you: a validation pass on the Partner Center owner column + any missing Partner Center tenant IDs.
- Timing: if possible, can your marketplace ops team confirm the first 200 accounts by end of this week? That will let us test a small reconciliation run and validate our routing logic.

Proposed next steps (we can keep this lightweight):
1) You validate the Partner Center owner column in the attached sheet (add notes in the "pc_notes" column).
2) We run a reconciliation job to flag conflicts (duplicate owners, orphan referrals).
3) Agree on a fallback owner policy for cases that remain unresolved.

I[0m've copied Vanessa and Karthik — they'll help with mapping policy and downstream routing. Happy to hop on a 30-min screen share if that is easier.

Thanks,

Nikhil Sharma
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachment: contoso_account_anchor_map_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@contoso.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace@contoso.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Contoso Partner Center seller anchor map & next steps

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the clear doc. Quick notes after a first pass: 

- We can validate the first 200 accounts by Friday EOD PST. I'll assign this to our marketplace ops queue.
- Two things to flag: some accounts in your sheet are using legacy account numbers — we'll add a column with the canonical tenant ID.
- For fallback owners, Contoso prefers to use the "Partner Success" queue for any orphan referrals; I'll include the queue owner in the sheet.

I'll ask my team to populate the "pc_confirmed_owner" column and add tenant IDs where available. If you want a live session, I'm available Tue (9–11 PST) or Wed (1–3 PST).

Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Marketplace Partnerships Manager, Contoso
alicia.gomez@contoso.com

Attachment: partnercenter-consent-instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@contoso.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Contoso Partner Center seller anchor map & next steps

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding Alicia's note. She can confirm 200 accounts by Friday. Can you both: 

- Review our fallback policy draft below and suggest edits.
- Confirm whether we should treat "Partner Success" as a hard fallback owner or only use it after a 7-day triage window.

Fallback policy draft:
- If Partner Center owner exists: route to that owner.
- If Partner Center owner missing AND account is named on Contoso confirmed list: route to field seller.
- If owner missing AND not on confirmed list: route to Contoso Partner Success queue (fallback) for triage.
- Allow automatic reassign to Redwood CS if Contoso fails to triage after 7 days.

Note: once Alicia's team returns the sheet we'll run a reconciliation job that emits: conflict count, orphan count, and a suggested owner assignment file. We want to run it against a 200-account pilot before scaling to all in-scope accounts.

Thoughts?

—Nikhil

Hi all — quick update from the ops team. We completed the 200-account validation; key takeaways: 

- 178 accounts had clear Partner Center owners matched.
- 14 accounts are using legacy IDs and we added canonical tenant IDs in the sheet.
- 8 accounts are orphaned — we placed them into the Partner Success queue as discussed.

I've uploaded the validated workbook to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_contoso-referral-mapping (see tab "pc_validated_200").

Next actions we agreed on the call: 
- Redwood runs the reconciliation job against the validated 200 and returns conflict/orphan report by Tue EOD.
- Contoso will review any conflict rows and confirm final owners within 3 business days.

Thanks — Alicia
